review_text:
Come here hungry, leave even more HAN-GRY….!

The food taste however is nice 👌 NGL… medium spicy was just enough.. but as a girl eating this 2-3pax is disappointing.. somore for Rm39 in total with rice & drinks…. it’s not even enough for me, myself!!  Head over to K88 foodcourt the same claypot chicken, damn good and the price reasonable for 1pax pot rm17 can share enough for two pax!

However good on matching the competitors around with rm3 refillable rice + drinks!

review_text:
What a scam! The staff clearly told my friends and I that the cheese tofu and enoki mushroom were FREE TODAY, so we added them to our orders.

At payment, they suddenly charged us and said, “It’s not free because you added it yourself,”????????

What a convenient way to play with words. Tell customers something is free, let them order it, then charge them afterwards and refuse a refund. 👍👍👍

PLEASE THINK TWICE AND BE CAUTIOUS IF YOU’RE PLANNING TO COME HERE!!!

Thank you for your feedback. We will continue to improve our systems and the quality of our staff to minimize such misunderstandings.

review_text:
I have been here 3 separate times, including today. The food is great, however, I do wish that the staff paid more attention to detail.

The 1st time I was here, I ordered a dry chicken pot. No problems.

The 2nd time I was here, I ordered a gravy level beef pot, with potatoes and tofu skin. The tofu skin was replaced with fried fuzhok by mistake. There was also no gravy sauce, it looked the same as the dry pot.

Today I ordered a soup level pork belly pot, with tofu skin again, along with bokchoy and pork balls. Only 1 out of the 3 add on ingredients made it to my table. Ofcourse I let them know and they fixed it right away.
